# Talents & Abilities {#sec-chapter-talents-abilities}

```{=typst}
#label("sec-chapter-talents-abilities")
```

![Illo 16: Talents Art](../assets/images/page037-img025.png){width="60%"}

*Illustration 16: Talents & abilities chapter art (Intellect class). Placeholder; final art TBD. Dimensions: 1024×1024.*

{{< pagebreak >}}

Talents are passive. They change your numbers or grant a standing benefit, and they are always on. Abilities are active. Spells, weapon maneuvers, and class powers must be activated to use. Both use the card format below.

Every card lists its Disciplines, Action, Range, and Keywords. The Novice effect appears as Weak, Standard, and Strong outcomes. Adept and Master additions follow. A card costs DP by tier: Novice 2 DP, Adept 4 DP, Master 8 DP. See @sec-chapter-disciplines for tier, Discipline, and cost rules. See @sec-chapter-magic-system for casting rules.

Bonuses from different talents stack. The same talent cannot be taken more than once.

{{< pagebreak >}}

## Talents

The talents below are general. Any class may take any of them.

### Fortune's Favor (Talent)

**Disciplines:** None · **Action:** Reaction · **Range:** Self · **Keywords:** Reroll

**Weak:** Once per session, reroll one natural 1.

**Standard:** Once per session, reroll one natural 1 or 2.

**Strong:** Once per session, reroll one natural 1, 2, or 3.

**Adept:** Once per scene, reroll one natural 1 or 2.

**Master:** Once per scene, reroll any one die.

### Combat Reflexes (Talent)

**Disciplines:** None · **Action:** Passive · **Range:** Self · **Keywords:** Reaction

**Weak:** You gain one extra Reaction per round.

**Standard:** You gain one extra Reaction per round.

**Strong:** You gain one extra Reaction per round.

**Adept:** You gain one extra Reaction per round and +1 Initiative.

**Master:** You gain two extra Reactions per round.

### Tough (Talent)

**Disciplines:** None · **Action:** Passive · **Range:** Self · **Keywords:** HP

**Weak:** +2 maximum HP.

**Standard:** +2 maximum HP.

**Strong:** +2 maximum HP.

**Adept:** +4 maximum HP.

**Master:** +6 maximum HP.

### Weapon Focus (Talent)

**Disciplines:** 1 chosen weapon Discipline · **Action:** Passive · **Range:** Self · **Keywords:** Damage

**Weak:** +1 damage tier on ability cards of the chosen weapon Discipline.

**Standard:** +1 damage tier on ability cards of the chosen weapon Discipline.

**Strong:** +1 damage tier on ability cards of the chosen weapon Discipline.

**Adept:** +1 damage tier on ability cards of the chosen weapon Discipline.

**Master:** +1 damage tier on ability cards of the chosen weapon Discipline.

### Skill Focus (Talent)

**Disciplines:** None · **Action:** Passive · **Range:** Self · **Keywords:** Skill

**Weak:** +1 to one skill you choose.

**Standard:** +1 to one skill you choose.

**Strong:** +1 to one skill you choose.

**Adept:** +2 to one skill you choose.

**Master:** +3 to one skill you choose.

### Iron Will (Talent)

**Disciplines:** None · **Action:** Passive · **Range:** Self · **Keywords:** Save

**Weak:** +1 to saves against fear and charm.

**Standard:** +1 to saves against fear and charm.

**Strong:** +1 to saves against fear and charm.

**Adept:** +2 to saves against fear and charm.

**Master:** +3 to saves against fear and charm.

### Bulwark (Talent)

**Disciplines:** None · **Action:** Passive · **Range:** Self · **Keywords:** DR, Defend

**Weak:** When you take the Defend maneuver, one adjacent ally gains +1 DR until the start of your next turn.

**Standard:** When you take the Defend maneuver, adjacent allies gain +1 DR until the start of your next turn.

**Strong:** When you take the Defend maneuver, adjacent allies gain +2 DR until the start of your next turn.

**Adept:** When you take the Defend maneuver, allies within 10 ft gain +2 DR until the start of your next turn.

**Master:** When you take the Defend maneuver, allies within 10 ft gain +3 DR until the start of your next turn.

### Refuse to Fall (Talent)

**Disciplines:** None · **Action:** Reaction · **Range:** Self · **Keywords:** HP

**Weak:** When you drop to 0 HP, drop to 1 HP instead. Once per session.

**Standard:** When you drop to 0 HP, drop to 1 HP and gain temporary HP equal to your level. Once per session.

**Strong:** When you drop to 0 HP, drop to 1 HP and gain temporary HP equal to twice your level. Once per session.

**Adept:** You may use this twice per session.

**Master:** You may use this once per scene.

### Death Blow (Talent)

**Disciplines:** None · **Action:** Passive · **Range:** Self · **Keywords:** Critical, Damage

**Weak:** On a Critical, the attack deals +1 damage tier (one row up on the damage budget, maximum 21).

**Standard:** On a Critical, the attack deals +1 damage tier (one row up on the damage budget, maximum 21).

**Strong:** On a Critical, the attack deals +1 damage tier (one row up on the damage budget, maximum 21).

**Adept:** On a Critical, the attack deals +1 damage tier (one row up on the damage budget, maximum 21), and one adjacent enemy takes 6 damage.

**Master:** On a Critical, deal maximum Strong damage and roll the critical bonus twice.

### Arcane Reservoir (Talent)

**Disciplines:** None · **Action:** Passive · **Range:** Self · **Keywords:** Spell

**Weak:** Once per session, cast a Novice spell you know a second time in the same turn.

**Standard:** Once per session, cast an Adept spell you know a second time in the same turn.

**Strong:** Once per session, cast a Master spell you know a second time in the same turn.

**Adept:** Once per scene, cast a Novice or Adept spell you know a second time in the same turn.

**Master:** Once per scene, cast a Master spell you know a second time in the same turn.

### Miracle Worker (Talent)

**Disciplines:** None · **Action:** Reaction · **Range:** 30 ft · **Keywords:** Healing

**Weak:** When an ally within 30 ft drops to 0 HP, they drop to 1 HP instead. Once per session.

**Standard:** When an ally within 30 ft drops to 0 HP, they drop to 1 HP instead. Once per session.

**Strong:** When an ally within 30 ft drops to 0 HP, they drop to 1 HP and regain half their maximum HP. Once per session.

**Adept:** Once per scene, when an ally within 30 ft drops to 0 HP, they drop to 1 HP instead.

**Master:** Once per scene, when an ally within 30 ft drops to 0 HP, they drop to 1 HP and regain half their maximum HP.

### Arcane Sensitivity (Talent)

**Disciplines:** None · **Action:** Passive · **Range:** Self · **Keywords:** Spell

**Weak:** +1 to spell rolls for one Discipline you choose.

**Standard:** +1 to spell rolls for one Discipline you choose.

**Strong:** +1 to spell rolls for one Discipline you choose.

**Adept:** +2 to spell rolls for one Discipline you choose.

**Master:** +3 to spell rolls for one Discipline you choose.

### Spell Reservoir (Talent)

**Disciplines:** None · **Action:** Passive · **Range:** Self · **Keywords:** Spell

**Weak:** Once per scene, cast a Novice spell you know a second time.

**Standard:** Once per scene, cast a Novice spell you know a second time.

**Strong:** Once per scene, cast an Adept spell you know a second time.

**Adept:** Once per scene, cast a Novice or Adept spell you know a second time.

**Master:** Once per scene, cast any spell you know a second time.

### Spell Storm (Talent)

**Disciplines:** None · **Action:** Passive · **Range:** Self · **Keywords:** Spell, Area

**Weak:** Once per session, a single-target spell you cast also hits one other target within 10 ft.

**Standard:** Once per session, a single-target spell you cast hits all targets you choose within 15 ft.

**Strong:** Once per session, a single-target spell you cast hits all targets you choose within 15 ft.

**Adept:** Once per scene, a single-target spell you cast hits all targets you choose within 15 ft.

**Master:** Once per scene, a single-target spell you cast hits all targets you choose within 20 ft.

### Linguist (Talent)

**Disciplines:** 1 Lore · **Action:** Passive · **Range:** Self · **Keywords:** Language

**Weak:** You read and speak one additional language.

**Standard:** You read and speak one additional language.

**Strong:** You read and speak one additional language.

**Adept:** You read and speak one additional language per rank of Lore you have.

**Master:** You read, write, and speak one additional language per rank of Lore you have.

### Battlefield Assessment (Talent)

**Disciplines:** 1 Tactics · **Action:** Action · **Range:** Sight · **Keywords:** Tactics

**Weak:** Once per scene, learn whether one enemy in sight is weaker, equal, or stronger than you.

**Standard:** Once per scene, learn the relative strength of every enemy in sight.

**Strong:** Once per scene, learn the relative strength of every enemy in sight and their highest attribute.

**Adept:** Once per scene, learn the relative strength of every enemy in sight and their highest attribute.

**Master:** Once per scene, learn the relative strength of every enemy in sight, their highest attribute, and one damage resistance or vulnerability.

### Quick Study (Talent)

**Disciplines:** None · **Action:** Free · **Range:** Self · **Keywords:** Skill

**Weak:** Once per session, use a skill you do not have at Novice (+1) for one check.

**Standard:** Once per session, use a skill you do not have at Novice (+1) for one check.

**Strong:** Once per session, use a skill you do not have at Novice (+1) for one check.

**Adept:** Once per scene, use a skill you do not have at Novice (+1) for one check.

**Master:** Once per scene, use a skill you do not have at Adept (+2) for one check.

### Chaotic Insight (Talent)

**Disciplines:** None · **Action:** Reaction · **Range:** Self · **Keywords:** Reroll

**Weak:** Once per session, reroll any roll you just made, using fresh dice.

**Standard:** Once per session, reroll any roll you just made, using fresh dice.

**Strong:** Once per session, reroll any roll you just made, using fresh dice.

**Adept:** Once per scene, reroll any roll you just made, using fresh dice.

**Master:** Once per scene, reroll any roll you just made, using fresh dice with a Boon.

### Rally the Troops (Talent)

**Disciplines:** None · **Action:** Maneuver · **Range:** 30 ft · **Keywords:** Frightened

**Weak:** Once per session, one ally within 30 ft removes one Frightened condition.

**Standard:** Once per session, all allies within 30 ft remove one Frightened condition.

**Strong:** Once per session, all allies within 30 ft remove one Frightened condition and gain a Boon on their next roll.

**Adept:** Once per scene, all allies within 30 ft remove one Frightened condition.

**Master:** Once per scene, all allies within 30 ft remove one Frightened or Dazed condition.

### Dangerous Gambit (Talent)

**Disciplines:** None · **Action:** Passive · **Range:** Self · **Keywords:** Damage

**Weak:** Once per scene, when you roll 16 or higher, increase the damage tier of the result by one.

**Standard:** Once per scene, when you roll 15 or higher, increase the damage tier of the result by one.

**Strong:** Once per scene, when you roll 14 or higher, increase the damage tier of the result by one.

**Adept:** Once per scene, when you roll 14 or higher, increase the damage tier of the result by one.

**Master:** Twice per scene, when you roll 14 or higher, increase the damage tier of the result by one.

### Trap Sense (Talent)

**Disciplines:** None · **Action:** Passive · **Range:** Self · **Keywords:** Boon, Traps

**Weak:** Boon on checks to detect traps.

**Standard:** Boon on checks to detect traps.

**Strong:** Boon on checks to detect and disarm traps.

**Adept:** Boon on checks to detect and disarm traps.

**Master:** Boon on checks to detect and disarm traps, and you cannot be surprised by a trap.

## Basic Attacks

These four cards are the attacks every character can make, no Discipline required. They are the floor. Weapon Disciplines gate access to stronger cards, not higher damage. See @sec-chapter-combat for attack and damage rules.

### Basic Melee (Basic Attack)

**Disciplines:** None · **Action:** Action · **Range:** Melee · **Keywords:** Damage

**Weak:** 1 + Brawn damage (Agility with a Finesse weapon).

**Standard:** 2 + Brawn damage (Agility with a Finesse weapon).

**Strong:** 3 + Brawn damage (Agility with a Finesse weapon).

**Adept:** Damage remains 1/2/3 + Brawn.

**Master:** Damage remains 1/2/3 + Brawn.

### Basic Archery (Basic Attack)

**Disciplines:** None · **Action:** Action · **Range:** 60/120 ft · **Keywords:** Damage

**Weak:** 1 damage.

**Standard:** 2 damage.

**Strong:** 3 damage.

**Adept:** Damage remains 1/2/3.

**Master:** Damage remains 1/2/3.

### Basic Thrown (Basic Attack)

**Disciplines:** None · **Action:** Action · **Range:** 20/60 ft · **Keywords:** Damage

**Weak:** 1 damage.

**Standard:** 2 damage.

**Strong:** 3 damage.

**Adept:** Damage remains 1/2/3.

**Master:** Damage remains 1/2/3.

### Basic Unarmed (Basic Attack)

**Disciplines:** None · **Action:** Action · **Range:** Melee · **Keywords:** Damage

**Weak:** 1 + Brawn damage.

**Standard:** 1 + Brawn damage.

**Strong:** 2 + Brawn damage.

**Adept:** Damage remains 1/1/2 + Brawn.

**Master:** Damage remains 1/1/2 + Brawn.

## Weapon Maneuvers

Maneuvers spend your Action, Reaction, or Maneuver as listed on each card. Each is gated by weapon Disciplines. See @sec-chapter-combat for Action, Maneuver, and Reaction rules.

### Riposte (Weapon Maneuver)

**Disciplines:** 2 Blades · **Action:** Reaction · **Range:** Melee · **Keywords:** Counterattack

**Weak:** When an enemy deals Weak damage to you, counterattack for 2.

**Standard:** When an enemy deals Weak damage to you, counterattack for 4.

**Strong:** When an enemy deals Weak damage to you, counterattack for 6.

**Adept:** Counterattack for 6/9/12.

**Master:** Counterattack for 9/15/21.

### Power Strike (Weapon Maneuver)

**Disciplines:** 2 Blades · **Action:** Action · **Range:** Melee · **Keywords:** Damage

**Weak:** +1 damage tier on your next weapon attack.

**Standard:** +1 damage tier on your next weapon attack.

**Strong:** +1 damage tier on your next weapon attack.

**Adept:** +1 damage tier on your next weapon attack.

**Master:** +1 damage tier on your next weapon attack.

### Cyclone (Weapon Maneuver)

**Disciplines:** 3 Blades · **Action:** Action · **Range:** Melee · **Keywords:** Area

**Weak:** Hit all adjacent enemies for 2 damage.

**Standard:** Hit all adjacent enemies for 4 damage.

**Strong:** Hit all adjacent enemies for 6 damage.

**Adept:** Hit all adjacent enemies for 6/9/12 damage.

**Master:** Hit all adjacent enemies for 9/15/21 damage; a Strong result Prone.

### Cleave (Weapon Maneuver)

**Disciplines:** 2 Axes · **Action:** Action · **Range:** Melee · **Keywords:** Chain

**Weak:** Hit one target. If it drops to 0 HP, hit an adjacent enemy for the same damage.

**Standard:** Hit one target. If it drops to 0 HP, hit an adjacent enemy for the same damage.

**Strong:** Hit one target. If it drops to 0 HP, hit an adjacent enemy for the same damage.

**Adept:** The follow-up may chain to a second adjacent enemy if that one also drops.

**Master:** The follow-up may chain to every adjacent enemy that drops, one after another.

### Pinpoint Strike (Weapon Maneuver)

**Disciplines:** 1 Blades · **Action:** Action · **Range:** Melee · **Keywords:** Piercing, Damage

**Weak:** +1 damage tier on your next weapon attack, and Piercing 1.

**Standard:** +1 damage tier on your next weapon attack, and Piercing 2.

**Strong:** +1 damage tier on your next weapon attack, and Piercing 3.

**Adept:** +1 damage tier on your next weapon attack, and Piercing 1/2/3.

**Master:** +1 damage tier on your next weapon attack, and Piercing 1/2/3.

### Shield Block (Weapon Maneuver)

**Disciplines:** 2 Armor · **Action:** Reaction · **Range:** Self · **Keywords:** DR

**Weak:** Reduce one attack against you by your shield DR + 2.

**Standard:** Reduce one attack against you by your shield DR + 4.

**Strong:** Reduce one attack against you by your shield DR + 6.

**Adept:** Reduce one attack against you by your shield DR + 6/9/12.

**Master:** Reduce one attack against you by your shield DR + 9; the attacker takes 2 damage.

### Shield Bash (Weapon Maneuver)

**Disciplines:** 2 Armor · **Action:** Maneuver · **Range:** Melee · **Keywords:** Prone, Push

**Weak:** Deal 1 damage and Push 5 ft.

**Standard:** Deal 2 damage and Push 5 ft.

**Strong:** Deal 3 damage and Push 5 ft; the target is Prone.

**Adept:** Deal 2/4/6 damage and Push 5 ft; a Strong result Prone.

**Master:** Deal 6/9/12 damage and Push 5 ft; a Strong result Prone and the target loses its Maneuver.

### Parry (Weapon Maneuver)

**Disciplines:** 2 Blades · **Action:** Reaction · **Range:** Self · **Keywords:** DR, Counterattack

**Weak:** +2 DR against one attack.

**Standard:** +4 DR against one attack.

**Strong:** +6 DR against one attack and counterattack for 2 damage.

**Adept:** +6/9/12 DR against one attack; a Strong result counterattack for 2.

**Master:** +9/15/21 DR against one attack; a Strong result counterattack for 4.

### Disarm (Weapon Maneuver)

**Disciplines:** 2 Blades · **Action:** Maneuver · **Range:** Melee · **Keywords:** Bane

**Weak:** The target keeps its grip.

**Standard:** The target's next attack with that weapon is at Bane.

**Strong:** The target drops the weapon.

**Adept:** The target's next two attacks with that weapon are at Bane; a Strong result drops the weapon.

**Master:** The target's next two attacks with that weapon are at Bane; a Strong result drops the weapon 10 ft away.

### Trip (Weapon Maneuver)

**Disciplines:** 2 Polearms · **Action:** Maneuver · **Range:** Melee · **Keywords:** Prone

**Weak:** The target is Prone.

**Standard:** The target is Prone and loses its Maneuver.

**Strong:** The target is Prone and loses its Action.

**Adept:** On Strong, the target is Prone and loses its Action and Maneuver.

**Master:** On Standard, the target is Prone and loses its Action; on Strong, the target is Prone and loses its Action and Maneuver.

### Charge (Weapon Maneuver)

**Disciplines:** 2 Heavy Weapon · **Action:** Action · **Range:** Melee · **Keywords:** Movement, Damage

**Weak:** Move up to your Speed and make one attack at +1 damage tier.

**Standard:** Move up to your Speed and make one attack at +1 damage tier.

**Strong:** Move up to your Speed and make one attack at +1 damage tier.

**Adept:** Move up to your Speed and make one attack at +1 damage tier.

**Master:** Move up to your Speed and make one attack at +1 damage tier.

### Brace (Weapon Maneuver)

**Disciplines:** 2 Polearms · **Action:** Reaction · **Range:** Self · **Keywords:** DR

**Weak:** +2 DR against a charge; the attacker takes 2 damage.

**Standard:** +2 DR against a charge; the attacker takes 4 damage.

**Strong:** +2 DR against a charge; the attacker takes 6 damage.

**Adept:** +2 DR against a charge; the attacker takes 6/9/12 damage.

**Master:** +2 DR against a charge; the attacker takes 9/15/21 damage.

### Dual Strike (Weapon Maneuver)

**Disciplines:** 1 Blades · **Action:** Action · **Range:** Melee · **Keywords:** Two attacks

**Weak:** Two attacks, each dealing 1 damage (2 total).

**Standard:** Two attacks, each dealing 2 damage (4 total).

**Strong:** Two attacks, each dealing 3 damage (6 total).

**Adept:** Two attacks for 6/9/12 damage total.

**Master:** Two attacks for 9/15/21 damage total.

### Crushing Blow (Weapon Maneuver)

**Disciplines:** 2 Heavy Weapon · **Action:** Action · **Range:** Melee · **Keywords:** Damage, Prone

**Weak:** +1 damage tier on your next weapon attack.

**Standard:** +1 damage tier on your next weapon attack.

**Strong:** +1 damage tier on your next weapon attack; the target is Prone.

**Adept:** +1 damage tier on your next weapon attack; a Strong result Prone.

**Master:** +1 damage tier on your next weapon attack; a Strong result Prone.

### Executioner's Cut (Weapon Maneuver)

**Disciplines:** 2 Axes · **Action:** Action · **Range:** Melee · **Keywords:** Damage, Wounded

**Weak:** +1 damage tier against a wounded target.

**Standard:** +1 damage tier against a wounded target.

**Strong:** +1 damage tier against a wounded target.

**Adept:** +1 damage tier against a wounded target.

**Master:** +1 damage tier against a wounded target.

### Throw (Weapon Maneuver)

**Disciplines:** 1 Archery · **Action:** Action · **Range:** 30 ft · **Keywords:** Ranged

**Weak:** Throw a weapon up to 30 ft at +1 damage tier.

**Standard:** Throw a weapon up to 30 ft at +1 damage tier.

**Strong:** Throw a weapon up to 30 ft at +1 damage tier.

**Adept:** Throw a weapon up to 60 ft at +1 damage tier.

**Master:** Throw a weapon up to 90 ft at +1 damage tier.

### Overrun (Weapon Maneuver)

**Disciplines:** 2 Heavy Weapon · **Action:** Action · **Range:** Melee · **Keywords:** Movement, Prone

**Weak:** Move through one enemy's space.

**Standard:** Move through one enemy's space.

**Strong:** Move through one enemy's space; the target is Prone.

**Adept:** Move through one enemy's space; on Standard or Strong, the target is Prone.

**Master:** Move through up to two enemies' spaces; on Standard or Strong, the targets are Prone.

### Renewal (Weapon Maneuver)

**Disciplines:** 1 Protection · **Action:** Maneuver, once per scene · **Range:** Self · **Keywords:** Healing

**Weak:** Regain 2 HP.

**Standard:** Regain 4 HP.

**Strong:** Regain 6 HP.

**Adept:** Regain 6/9/12 HP.

**Master:** Regain 9/15/21 HP.
